title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.31465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients. To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC

translated_title: 基于引文关联病例报告的临床相似图像对数据集：用于医学图像检索
translated_abstract: 检索与给定患者临床相似的患者图像可以支持诊断、教学和研究。训练和评估检索系统需要知道不同患者的哪些图像显示相同的发现，而现有数据集规模较小或范围狭窄。我们构建了PMC-PaIR数据集，包含来自56,013篇开放获取的PubMed Central病例报告的86,144对临床相似图像，这些病例报告通常记录罕见或具有挑战性的病例表现。我们开发了一种跟随引文的方法，因为引文通常链接相似患者的病例报告。为了确定两个关联病例在临床上的共同之处，该方法提示大语言模型生成并回答分层问题（从检查模态到诊断和发现），并使用答案通过说明文字匹配图像。专家认为这些图像对具有很高的准确性，且这种问题引导的方法找到的正确图像对数量是直接匹配方法的两倍。在PMC上微调BiomedCLIP……
tldr: 该研究构建了包含86,144对临床相似图像的PMC-PaIR数据集，通过跟随引文并利用大语言模型生成和回答分层问题来匹配病例图像，为医学图像检索系统的训练与评估提供了高质量的大规模数据资源。
en_tdlr: The study constructs PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 clinically similar image pairs from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, using a citation-following approach with large language models answering hierarchical questions to match images, providing a large-scale high-quality resource for training and evaluating medical image retrieval systems.
